weight_semantics: link length as distributed in the TNTP `length` column (KILOMETRES -- the in-file ORIGINAL HEADER reads 'length (km)')
preprocessing: TNTP header declares 33113 nodes, 75379 directed links, 3264 traffic analysis zones. The published network was kept intact -- the zone-centroid nodes (ids 1..3264) and their artificial centroid-connector links were NOT removed. The `length` column is strictly positive on every link in this file (the `free_flow_time` column is not, which is why length was used). Source is DIRECTED: symmetrised by keeping the MINIMUM length among the directed arcs joining a node pair (36417 arcs collapsed into an existing pair); 0 self-loops removed. No unit conversion. Source: Veitch Lister Consultancy, Brisbane; provided by M. Bliemer, converted to TNTP by D. Rey. Graph before LCC extraction: 33113 nodes, 38962 edges, 12 connected component(s); kept the largest (32956 nodes). Node ids relabelled 0..n-1 in sorted order of the original labels.
